units: <cite ref="Eruvin 63a:12">Erub. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>אסר ליה לחמריה בצ׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>בצִינְּיָיתָא</he>; Ms. O. <he>בצִינְּיָתָא</he>; ed. Sonc. a. Alf. <he>בצ׳ דדיקלא</he>) tied his ass to a palm (palms) on the Sabbath.—Pl. <cite ref="R00394"><he>צִינְּיָיתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="R00397"><he>צִינְּיָתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="R00399"><he>צִנְּ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sotah 46b:16">Sot. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>עד בי צ׳ דבבל</he> to the place called ‘between the palms’ of Babylonia; <cite ref="Sotah 46b:16">ib.</cite> <he>הני צ׳ דבבל וכ׳</he> those palms of Babylonia date frome the days of Adam; <cite ref="Berakhot 31a:14">Ber. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>צניתא</he>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 96b:9">Snh. 96ᵇ</cite> <he>דצ׳</he> (<cite ref="R00768"><he>צרידתא</he></cite>) <he>דבבל</he> (Var. in Rashi: <cite ref="R00390"><he>צִינוֹנְיָיתָא</he></cite>; Ms. M. <he>צ׳ צרורתא</he>; Ms. F. <he>צ׳ צרייאתא</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 400) the waters along the (dry, or stony) palms of Babylonia.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 24b">B. Mets. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>בצ׳ דבי וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>בי ציבתא</he>; Ms. R. <he>בי ציניתא</he>; Ms. O. <he>בי צִינָּתָא</he>) between the palms of the estate of Bar Marion. [<cite ref="Shabbat 139b:17">Sabb. 139ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="R00302"><he>צִיבְּתָא</he></cite>.]
